html:Der sker et skifte på det danske bo: A shift is happening in the Danish property market that few are talking openly about: the large institutional investors are on their way out of residential letting. As a result of the Whitsun package, institutional investors must now pay ⟦0⟧ % tax on value increases on properties, and combined with historically low yields, this has scared professional capital funds and pension funds away from residential investment. For the private investor, this could be an opening — but only if you know the rules of the game.
